new_claims.statement: If concentration is bounded simultaneously by H1 eps^(1/2) and H2 eps^(2/3), then sup_z E|R-z|^-1/2 <= H1[4+3 log_+(H2/H1^(4/3))].

For a two-original-coordinate packet with rank-two cross matrix M, Delta=sqrt(det(MM^T)), and aggregate physical star S=sqrt(B12^2+||row_j M||^2), sup_t E|R-t|^-1/2 <=2^(9/4)S^-1/2[4+log_+(27S^2/(16Delta))].
int |u|^-1/2 |phi_R(u)|^2 du <=2^(11/4)sqrt(pi)S^-1/2[4+log_+(27S^2/(16Delta))], with the whole independent copy retained.
With one disjoint original square d[Z+h]^2, ||p_Q||inf <=2^(9/4)|d|^-1/2 S^-1/2[4+log_+(27S^2/(16Delta))].
